justification: Widens the rule-wording test the page-coverage guard uses to decide a page holds rules (a stricter guard: more pages must be covered), and stops the quality report crashing on a rule with no heading.

pre_impl.existing_data: no database change; RULE_WORDS is a regex read by ai_extractor._rule_bearing_pages and page_coverage.skipped_pages
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: councils write rules as 'are not to exceed' and 'is to comply', which the old list missed; plain 'is to the north' must still not count
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: applies to the next extraction of any chapter; nothing already stored changes
pre_impl.external_source_error: none: regex and a print statement; the quality report still runs read-only SELECTs
pre_impl.frontend_type: no frontend change: both files are backend extraction scripts and no served field changes
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: a stricter guard may refuse a chapter it passed before, loudly with the page numbers, never silently

functions.name: page_coverage.RULE_WORDS
functions.input: a line or page of PDF text read from a council's development control plan
functions.output: a match when the text carries rule wording, now including 'are not to' and 'is to comply/exceed/provide/be'
functions.if_none: no match: the line or page is treated as holding no rule words, as before

values.if_missing: prints '(no heading)' instead of raising TypeError

queries.purpose: none changed: the quality report's existing read-only SELECT of a council's current provisions
queries.where_clause: unchanged by this change: source_council = %s AND is_current
queries.if_zero: unchanged: the report prints an empty section
queries.if_wrong: unchanged: the report only prints, it writes nothing

break_it.scenario: A page of 'are not to exceed' rules is skipped by the reader
break_it.what_happens: the page was not counted as holding rules, so the chapter could be approved without those rules
break_it.how: RULE_WORDS now matches 'are not to' and 'is to comply/exceed/provide/be'

break_it.scenario: Plain prose 'is to the north' is counted as a rule
break_it.what_happens: history pages would be treated as rule pages and good chapters refused for skipping them
break_it.how: the bare 'is/are to' form needs a verb after it (comply, exceed, provide, be)

break_it.scenario: A rule with no section heading reaches the quality report
break_it.what_happens: TypeError crashed the gate, which then skipped the enrichment phases for the whole run
break_it.how: both header prints fall back to '(no heading)'

break_it.scenario: The stricter guard refuses a chapter mid-batch
break_it.what_happens: a chapter that passed yesterday is now refused with the pages that hold rules
break_it.how: refusal is loud (PageLoss with page numbers) and leaves the live rules unchanged; merged after the running batches end
break_it.repro: read scripts/ai_extractor.py _reread_skipped_pages: PageLoss names the pages

break_it.scenario: none changed in the query, yet the report is run on a council with NULL headers
break_it.what_happens: before this change the whole report raised and printed nothing useful for that council
break_it.how: the query is unchanged and its NULL headers are printed as '(no heading)'

falsifiable_check.fails_when: RULE_WORDS misses 'are not to exceed' or matches 'is to the north', or a header print is not null-safe
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before this change 'Front fences are not to exceed 1.2m in height.' did not match RULE_WORDS.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Sonnet trace 2026-10-13: ku_ring_gai has 8 current rules with NULL section_header, 2 over 10,000 chars.
